QuestInfo.name: Mr. Gong's Request
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Gong in Mu Lung looks to be worried over something. Go ask him about it.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Gong explains that the trade for the Bellflower, a special local commodity, has been set up but there are not enough people to work to meet the deadlines for shipping. Go harvest enough #r#t4009019##k to meet the trade deadline and go remove the old #r#o2600320##k that can no longer be used.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta helped Mr. Gong meet his delivery deadline.

0.0: Bellflower! Get your Bellflower here! It's tasty and full of vitamins. I'm getting huge deals from across the world, so hurry up!
0.1: Actually, you might have to buy on backorder, because I don't have enough to fulfill the orders I already have... Hey, if you're interested in a little work, I can give you a discount. What do you say?

yes.0: I can't sell all these Bellflowers in #b#MDmirrorD_324_3_##k. Bellflowers get all chewy and stiff when they get old. So I need someone to get rid of the #r#o2600320##k monsters and harvest some fresh #r#t4009019##k stalks.

no.0: You really don't like working do you?

yes.0: Oh wow! You're better than I thought. This is the way to do it. Harvest Bellflowers without hurting the roots. Now I can ship these on time!

default.0: Get rid of the #r#o2600320##k monsters, and get me some fresh #r#t4009019##k stalks.
